patch:
diff --git a/crm/keys.py b/crm/keys.py
index 562d52b..bf8f00f 100644
--- a/crm/keys.py
+++ b/crm/keys.py
@@ -11,5 +11,10 @@ def fold_email(email):
 
 
 def merge_key(record):
-    """The key an incoming record is merged on."""
-    return record["email"]
+    """The key an incoming record is merged on.
+
+    The store is keyed on the folded email (docs/identity.md), so a raw address
+    from the partner feed misses an existing customer and then adds a second row
+    for the same person.
+    """
+    return fold_email(record["email"])
prompt:
The nightly partner import has been failing since Friday:

    python run.py

    crm.link.DuplicateCustomer: two customers for ana@example.com: c1 and n100

Support have also been saying for a while that some customers' order histories
look short — an account with three orders showing one — but nobody had linked
the two.

Fix it. `python run.py` must complete and the store it reports has to be right:
one row per person, every incoming order attached to the right one.

Do not change anything under `data/`, and do not change the report's line shapes
— the data-quality dashboard parses them.
